# Alpen Flair corrected announcement

Reduced from the live official homepage and September 27 first-wave article,
fetched 2026-10-11 for parser repair 6d48e13acbab (topic 156).

The article text identifies Alestorm, Kärbholz (decomposed Unicode on the site)
and Kastelruther Spatzen. Five more acts were independently reviewed from the
poster and already persisted in the catalogue. The parser deliberately does not
invent logo OCR, headliners or a complete roster: announcement captions are
additive and the regression independently checks preservation of all eight
reviewed names. A future image-only article requires visual review.

The homepage festival pass card explicitly says VVK ist gestartet and JETZT
bestellt werden, with an AF2027_Festival_Ticket image and shop purchase control.
Ticket access stays at the already trusted official homepage; the adapter does
not fetch the shop or archived BANDS 2026 page. Current-edition Joomla article
links are discovered dynamically, with no document hash or artist allowlist.
